review_type: implementer code review, not independent security audit
reviewed_areas: bounded strict record encoding, CA/client/token binding and metadata-only public snapshots
platform-generated AES-GCM nonce and non-exportable AndroidKeyStore key
credential-protected noBackup and explicit new-identity precondition
private modes, UID/type/link checks, atomic CLOEXEC and descriptor ownership
revision, capacity, retained revocation, per-request checks and shared commit barrier
fixed public errors, no production logging/network, synthetic tests excluded from AAR
test_hooks: internal checkpoint hooks remain in library; public factories always use null; internal is not a same-UID security boundary

synthetic_token_scan.scope: known synthetic token in raw instrumentation, harness and build logs only

limitations: no Android host HTTP/PAKE/UI or activity-stream cancellation integration
no real phone, OEM backup migration or before-first-unlock boot test
no power loss or disk-full test
no simultaneous cross-process lock contention test
platform refused hardlinks before store nlink>1 branch
no hardware protection guarantee on emulators
same-UID malicious code/root and valid ciphertext rollback outside protection
host must prove CA was freshly generated
ciphertext temporary files can remain after process death
